344:/// Mints a Flunge-owned typed standing id.
345:///
346:/// The opaque id preserves the scope and classifier: `nat-{code}` for national
347:/// standings, `r{regionId}-{code}` for genuine per-region standings,
348:/// `rs-{code}` for `RegionalShared` (Division) categories, `uni-{code}`
349:/// for Unified standings, and `gb-{code}` for British Fencing standings. As a
350:/// derived, Flunge-owned record it uses the database system, yielding view
351:/// ids such as `s.d.nat-SRMF` and `s.d.r3-JRME`.
352:pub(crate) fn build_standing_key(
353:  scope: StandingScope,
354:  region_id: Option<u8>,
355:  code: &str,
356:) -> TypedId<StandingId> {
357:  let opaque_id = match (scope, region_id) {
358:    (StandingScope::National, _) => format!("nat-{code}"),
359:    (StandingScope::Regional, Some(region_id)) => format!("r{region_id}-{code}"),
360:    (StandingScope::Regional, None) => format!("rs-{code}"),
361:    (StandingScope::Unified, _) => format!("uni-{code}"),
362:    (StandingScope::British, _) => format!("gb-{code}"),
363:  };
364:  TypedId::<StandingId>::new_with_system(&opaque_id, System::Database)
365:}
366:
367:/// Parses and validates a server-minted standing key.
368:///
369:/// A syntactically valid `StandingId` alone is not sufficient: this endpoint
370:/// only accepts the database-owned `nat-`, `r{region}-`, `rs-`, `uni-`, and
371:/// `gb-` forms that [`build_standing_key`] creates.
372:pub(crate) fn parse_standing_key(raw: &str) -> Result<TypedId<StandingId>> {
373:  let key = parse_typed_id::<StandingId>(raw, "standing")
374:    .map_err(|_| StandingsError::InvalidStandingKey(raw.to_string()))?;
375:  if key.system() != &System::Database {
376:    return Err(StandingsError::InvalidStandingKey(raw.to_string()));
377:  }
378:
379:  let valid = match key.as_str().split_once('-') {
380:    Some(("nat", classifier))
381:    | Some(("rs", classifier))
382:    | Some(("uni", classifier))
383:    | Some(("gb", classifier)) => RecognizedClassifier::from_code(classifier).is_some(),
384:    Some((region, classifier)) => {
385:      region
386:        .strip_prefix('r')
387:        .and_then(|region| region.parse::<u8>().ok())
388:        .is_some_and(|region| region > 0)
389:        && RecognizedClassifier::from_code(classifier).is_some()
390:    }
391:    None => false,
392:  };
393:  if valid {
394:    Ok(key)
395:  } else {
396:    Err(StandingsError::InvalidStandingKey(raw.to_string()))
397:  }
398:}

445:async fn resolve_standings_usaf_id(fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>) -> Result<Option<u32>> {
446:  if let System::Usaf = fencer_id.system() {
447:    return Ok(fencer_id.usaf_id());
448:  }
449:  if let System::Database = fencer_id.system() {
450:    match DB.fencers.get_document(fencer_id.as_str()).await {
451:      Ok(Some(doc)) => {
452:        return Ok(
453:          doc
454:            .fields
455:            .id_detail
456:            .usaf_id
457:            .as_deref()
458:            .and_then(|id| id.parse().ok()),
459:        );
460:      }
461:      Ok(None) => return Ok(None),
462:      Err(err) => {
463:        warn!(
464:          fencer_id = %fencer_id,
465:          ?err,
466:          "DB lookup failed while resolving USAF id for standings"
467:        );
468:        return Err(StandingsError::Database(err.to_string()));
469:      }
470:    }
471:  }
472:  Ok(None)
473:}

498:  /// fencer. `None` covers non-regional rows, unresolved regions, cache
499:  /// misses, and read errors; none of those establishes absence, so serving
500:  /// falls back to the index.
501:  regional_member_present: Option<bool>,
502:}
503:
504:fn cached_standings_enrichment(
505:  scope: StandingScope,
506:  list: &[crate::usafencing::model::FencerStanding],
507:  usaf_id: u32,
508:) -> StandingEnrichment {
509:  let standing = list.iter().find(|standing| standing.id == Some(usaf_id));
510:  StandingEnrichment {
511:    points: standing.map(|standing| standing.points),
512:    entrants: Some(list.len()),
513:    unified_metadata: None,
514:    points_floor: None,
515:    unified_season: None,
516:    unified_counted: None,
517:    regional_member_present: (scope == StandingScope::Regional).then_some(standing.is_some()),
518:  }
519:}
520:
521:fn unified_enrichment(
522:  list: &unified_snapshot::UnifiedListPayload,
523:  usaf_id: u32,
524:  now: chrono::DateTime<Utc>,
525:) -> StandingEnrichment {
526:  // Membership id is the only identity shared with the connected-fencer
527:  // endpoint. USA Fencing's source_user_id is intentionally not used here:
528:  // it is a source-private structural join key, not a member number.
529:  let record = list
530:    .standings
531:    .iter()
532:    .find(|record| record.standing.id == Some(usaf_id));
533:
534:  StandingEnrichment {
535:    points: record.map(|record| record.standing.points),
536:    entrants: Some(list.standings.len()),
537:    unified_metadata: Some(unified_standing_metadata(list, now)),
538:    points_floor: record.and_then(|record| record.points_floor.clone()),
539:    unified_season: unified_list_season(list),
540:    unified_counted: record.map(|record| record.counted.clone()),
541:    regional_member_present: None,
542:  }
543:}
544:
545:async fn enrich_unified_ranking(
546:  classifier: RecognizedClassifier,
547:  usaf_id: u32,
548:) -> StandingEnrichment {
549:  match unified_snapshot::read_list(classifier).await {
550:    Ok(Some(list)) => unified_enrichment(&list, usaf_id, Utc::now()),
551:    Ok(None) => StandingEnrichment::default(),
552:    Err(err) => {
553:      warn!(
554:        classifier = %classifier,
555:        ?err,
556:        "Failed to read Unified standings snapshot for enrichment"
557:      );
558:      StandingEnrichment::default()
559:    }
560:  }
561:}
562:
563:async fn enrich_ranking(ranking: &CategoryRanking, usaf_id: u32) -> StandingEnrichment {
564:  let (hash_key, field) = match ranking.scope {
565:    StandingScope::Unified => return enrich_unified_ranking(ranking.classifier, usaf_id).await,
566:    StandingScope::National => (
567:      NATIONAL_STANDINGS_VIEW_CACHE_KEY,
568:      national_cache_field(ranking.classifier),
569:    ),
570:    StandingScope::Regional if ranking.regional_shared => (
571:      REGIONAL_STANDINGS_VIEW_CACHE_KEY,
572:      regional_cache_field(REGIONAL_SHARED_LOOKUP_REGION as u32, ranking.classifier),
573:    ),
574:    StandingScope::Regional => match ranking.usa_region {
575:      Some(region_id) => (
576:        REGIONAL_STANDINGS_VIEW_CACHE_KEY,
577:        regional_cache_field(region_id as u32, ranking.classifier),
578:      ),
579:      None => return StandingEnrichment::default(),
580:    },
581:    // `CategoryRanking` never carries `British`: British items are assembled
582:    // separately from the British Fencing licence index, not from
583:    // `standings_index::lookup_standings` (see the design doc's rejection of
584:    // putting British rows in `standings:index`). Kept exhaustive and
585:    // defensive rather than reachable.
586:    StandingScope::British => return StandingEnrichment::default(),
587:  };
588:
589:  match read_cached_standings(hash_key, &field).await {
590:    Ok(Some(list)) => cached_standings_enrichment(ranking.scope, &list, usaf_id),
591:    // A missing field has not established that this fencer is absent. This is
592:    // expected after a view-cache version or field-format change, until the
593:    // rebuild sweep writes the current-season list.
594:    Ok(None) => StandingEnrichment::default(),
595:    Err(err) => {
596:      warn!(
597:        cache_key = hash_key,
598:        cache_field = %field,
599:        ?err,
600:        "Failed to read cached standings for enrichment"
601:      );
602:      StandingEnrichment::default()
603:    }
604:  }
605:}
606:
607:/// Collapses stale old-format per-region Division entries into a single combined
608:/// regional row, matching what a freshly-built index would produce.
609:///
610:/// Old-format entries (pre-PR #682) for regional-shared categories have
611:/// `regional_shared = false` and `usa_region = Some(1..6)`. The new builder
612:/// stores a single `regional_shared = true, usa_region = None` entry instead.
613:/// This function normalizes both formats to the new shape at read time so the
614:/// endpoint is correct regardless of index freshness.
615:///
616:/// Genuine per-region categories (Junior/Cadet/Youth) are left untouched.
617:fn collapse_regional_shared_entries(rankings: Vec<CategoryRanking>) -> Vec<CategoryRanking> {
618:  use std::collections::HashMap;
619:
620:  let mut result: Vec<CategoryRanking> = Vec::new();
621:  // Collect old-format per-region entries keyed by classifier
622:  let mut stale_by_classifier: HashMap<RecognizedClassifier, Vec<CategoryRanking>> = HashMap::new();
623:
624:  for ranking in rankings {
625:    if ranking.scope != StandingScope::Regional
626:      || !is_regional_shared_category(ranking.classifier.category)
627:    {
628:      result.push(ranking);
629:      continue;
630:    }
631:    // New-format: already correctly stored — pass through directly.
632:    if ranking.regional_shared {
633:      result.push(ranking);
634:      continue;
635:    }
636:    // Old-format: accumulate per-region entries; will collapse below.
637:    stale_by_classifier
638:      .entry(ranking.classifier)
639:      .or_default()
640:      .push(ranking);
641:  }
642:
643:  // For each classifier with old-format entries, emit exactly one row.
644:  // Prefer the region-1 entry (matches what the builder fetches) for rank data.
645:  for (classifier, entries) in stale_by_classifier {
646:    let representative = entries
647:      .iter()
648:      .find(|e| e.usa_region == Some(REGIONAL_SHARED_LOOKUP_REGION))
649:      .or_else(|| entries.first());
650:
651:    if let Some(entry) = representative {
652:      result.push(CategoryRanking {
653:        scope: StandingScope::Regional,
654:        usa_region: None,
655:        regional_shared: true,
656:        classifier,
657:        rank: entry.rank.clone(),
658:      });
659:    }
660:  }
661:
662:  result
663:}
664:
665:/// Derives a fencer's home region from their standings. Junior/Cadet/Youth
666:/// regional lists are fetched **per region**, so a fencer only ever appears
667:/// on the one region's list matching their division — `region_id` on that
668:/// entry is therefore the fencer's home region, not just the list it came
669:/// from. `regional_shared` categories (Division) carry no `region_id` (a
670:/// single combined list across all regions) and never match. `None` when the
671:/// fencer holds no genuine per-region standing to derive one from.
672:pub(crate) fn fencer_home_region(standings: &FencerStandingsResponse) -> Option<u8> {
673:  standings.standings.iter().find_map(|item| item.region_id)
674:}
675:
676:/// Builds one served row, using the season-scoped regional view as the
677:/// membership authority for lists that reset wholesale. The shared legacy
678:/// index can still contain a row written by an older binary, but a missing
679:/// member in the current season's empty/new list must not become a standing.
680:/// Rolling RJCC rows remain index-authoritative across the season boundary.
681:fn fencer_standing_item(
682:  ranking: &CategoryRanking,
683:  enrichment: StandingEnrichment,
684:  unified_is_new: Option<bool>,
685:) -> Option<FencerStandingItem> {
686:  if ranking.scope == StandingScope::Regional
687:    && regional_list_is_season_reset(ranking.classifier.category)
688:    && enrichment.regional_member_present == Some(false)
689:  {
690:    return None;
691:  }
692:
693:  let scope = ranking.scope;
694:  let classifier = build_classifier_info(ranking.classifier);
695:  let key = build_standing_key(scope, ranking.usa_region, &classifier.code);
696:  Some(FencerStandingItem {
697:    key,
698:    scope,
699:    region_id: ranking.usa_region,
700:    classifier,
701:    rank: ranking.rank.clone(),
702:    points: enrichment.points,
703:    entrants: enrichment.entrants,
704:    movement: None,
705:    unified: if scope == StandingScope::Unified {
706:      Some(UnifiedStandingItemMetadata {
707:        freshness: SourceFreshness {
708:          source_updated_at: enrichment
709:            .unified_metadata
710:            .as_ref()
711:            .and_then(|metadata| metadata.source_updated_at),
712:          fetched_at: enrichment
713:            .unified_metadata
714:            .as_ref()
715:            .map(|metadata| metadata.fetched_at),
716:          is_stale: enrichment
717:            .unified_metadata
718:            .as_ref()
719:            .map(|metadata| metadata.is_stale),
720:        },
721:        list_code: enrichment
722:          .unified_metadata
723:          .as_ref()
724:          .map(|metadata| metadata.source_list_code.clone()),
725:        is_new: unified_is_new.expect("Unified rows require the Unified runtime flag"),
726:        points_floor: enrichment.points_floor.clone(),
727:        eligibility: enrichment.points.zip(enrichment.unified_season).and_then(
728:          |(points, season)| {
729:            let category = points_tables::national_event_eligibility::NationalEventCategory::for_classifier_category(
730:              ranking.classifier.category,
731:            )?;
732:            points_tables::national_event_eligibility::evaluate(category, points, season)
733:          },
734:        ),
735:        counted: enrichment.unified_counted.unwrap_or_default(),
736:      })
737:    } else {
738:      None
739:    },
740:    // `fencer_standing_item` only ever builds rows from `standings_index`
741:    // rankings, which never carry `British` -- see `enrich_ranking`'s
742:    // matching defensive arm. British items are built separately by
743:    // `british_standing_item_for_row`.
744:    british: None,
745:  })
746:}
747:
748:/// Gate on the viewing context: British standings are resolved only when
749:/// this tracked-fencer list includes `fencer_id`. The signed-in caller's
750:/// own list and a share-link owner's list are the two contexts; a public
751:/// unauthenticated request has neither and must not load the shared
752:/// licence. The licence itself is a property of the fencer, loaded
753:/// separately once this gate passes.
754:pub(crate) fn may_resolve_british_licence(
755:  tracked: &[TrackedFencer],
756:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
757:) -> bool {
758:  crate::share::is_connected_fencer(tracked, fencer_id)
759:}
760:
761:/// Resolves the shared British Fencing licence for `fencer_id` when the
762:/// viewing context tracks that fencer. Shared by the owner-scoped handler
763:/// below and the anonymous results-share view (`crate::share::view`), which
764:/// each pass a different tracked-fencer list -- the signed-in caller's own,
765:/// versus the share link owner's -- but need the identical lookup.
766:/// `None` covers "fencer not tracked by this context", "tracked with no
767:/// licence configured", and a load failure (warned, then omitted); every
768:/// caller degrades to no British items in those cases rather than erroring.
769:pub(crate) async fn licence_for_fencer(
770:  tracked: &[TrackedFencer],
771:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
772:) -> Option<String> {
773:  if !may_resolve_british_licence(tracked, fencer_id) {
774:    return None;
775:  }
776:  match crate::fencer_licence::get_membership_id(fencer_id).await {
777:    Ok(licence) => licence,
778:    Err(err) => {
779:      warn!(
780:        error = ?err,
781:        fencer_id = %fencer_id,
782:        "Failed to load shared British Fencing licence; omitting British standings"
783:      );
784:      None
785:    }
786:  }
787:}
788:
789:/// Assembles a fencer's current standings across every scope. `british_licence`
790:/// -- the shared fencer licence, when the viewing context is allowed to
791:/// resolve it -- is the internal assembly entry point's British extension:
792:/// `None` (the public route's default, and every in-process caller that has
793:/// no owner-scoped context, e.g. `crate::recommendations::standings`) omits
794:/// British items entirely, regardless of the runtime flag. `Some(licence)`
795:/// additionally assembles that licence's British items, still gated on
796:/// [`british_rankings_enabled`]. See
797:/// docs/design-docs/british-fencing-rankings-as-a-standings-source.md,
798:/// "Extending the response contract".
799:pub async fn get_fencer_standings(
800:  fencer_id: TypedId<FencerId>,
801:  british_licence: Option<&str>,
802:) -> Result<FencerStandingsResponse> {
803:  let usaf_id = resolve_standings_usaf_id(&fencer_id).await?;
804:
805:  let raw_rankings = if let Some(usaf_id) = usaf_id {
806:    standings_index::lookup_standings(usaf_id)
807:      .await
808:      .map_err(|e| StandingsError::StandingsIndex(e.to_string()))?
809:  } else {
810:    Vec::new()
811:  };
812:  let rankings = collapse_regional_shared_entries(raw_rankings);
813:  let unified_is_new = if rankings
814:    .iter()
815:    .any(|ranking| ranking.scope == StandingScope::Unified)
816:  {
817:    Some(unified_new_marker_enabled().await?)
818:  } else {
819:    None
820:  };
821:
822:  let mut items: Vec<FencerStandingItem> = Vec::with_capacity(rankings.len());
823:  for ranking in &rankings {
824:    let enrichment = if let Some(uid) = usaf_id {
825:      enrich_ranking(ranking, uid).await
826:    } else {
827:      StandingEnrichment::default()
828:    };
829:    if let Some(item) = fencer_standing_item(ranking, enrichment, unified_is_new) {
830:      items.push(item);
831:    }
832:  }
833:
834:  if let Some(licence) = british_licence {
835:    items.extend(british_standing_items(licence).await);
836:  }
837:
838:  sort_standings(&mut items);
839:
840:  Ok(fencer_standings_response(fencer_id, usaf_id, items))
841:}
842:
843:/// Shapes the response after USA Fencing and British items have been
844:/// assembled. `identity_resolved` deliberately reports USA Fencing identity
845:/// resolution only; British licence-matched items remain usable without one.
846:fn fencer_standings_response(
847:  fencer_id: TypedId<FencerId>,
848:  usaf_id: Option<u32>,
849:  standings: Vec<FencerStandingItem>,
850:) -> FencerStandingsResponse {
851:  FencerStandingsResponse {
852:    fencer_id,
853:    identity_resolved: usaf_id.is_some(),
854:    standings,
855:  }
856:}
857:
858:/// Assembles this licence's British Fencing standing items, one per
859:/// configured table it appears on, gated on [`british_rankings_enabled`].
860:/// Ingestion runs regardless of the flag; this is the only place a British
861:/// item is ever kept from the response. A read failure (a bad Redis
862:/// connection, a corrupted payload) degrades to no British items rather than
863:/// failing the whole standings response, matching every other secondary
864:/// enrichment source in this file (see [`enrich_ranking`]'s own
865:/// cache-miss-is-not-an-error handling).
866:async fn british_standing_items(licence: &str) -> Vec<FencerStandingItem> {
867:  match british_rankings_enabled().await {
868:    Ok(true) => {}
869:    Ok(false) => return Vec::new(),
870:    Err(error) => {
871:      warn!(
872:        licence,
873:        ?error,
874:        "Failed to read British rankings runtime flag; omitting British standings"
875:      );
876:      return Vec::new();
877:    }
878:  }
879:
880:  let mut conn = british_redis_connection().await;
881:  let entries = match british_fencing::store::read_licence_index_entries(&mut conn, licence).await {
882:    Ok(entries) => entries,
883:    Err(error) => {
884:      warn!(
885:        licence,
886:        ?error,
887:        "Failed to read British rankings licence index"
888:      );
889:      return Vec::new();
890:    }
891:  };
892:
893:  let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(entries.len());
894:  for entry in &entries {
895:    match british_standing_item(&mut conn, entry).await {
896:      Ok(Some(item)) => items.push(item),
897:      // Not-yet-ranked: the entry's own table has since dropped this row (or
898:      // the table was never published). No item for that table, no error,
899:      // no placeholder -- see the design doc's "Not-yet-ranked".
900:      Ok(None) => {}
901:      Err(error) => {
902:        warn!(
903:          licence,
904:          table_id = %entry.table_id,
905:          ?error,
906:          "Failed to read a British rankings table"
907:        );
908:      }
909:    }
910:  }
911:  items
912:}
913:
914:async fn british_redis_connection() -> redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection {
915:  RedisCache::get()
916:    .await
917:    .get_connection()
918:    .expect("RedisCache should provide a Redis connection")
919:}
920:
921:/// Resolves one licence-index entry into a standing item, tolerating the
922:/// entry's `row_index` having drifted out from under it: `row_index` is
923:/// re-derived on every refresh (see
924:/// [`british_fencing::store::LicenceIndexEntry`]'s doc), so a reader that
925:/// trusted it blindly could return a different fencer's row if a refresh
926:/// landed between the licence-index read and this one. Falls back to a scan
927:/// when the pointer no longer lines up.
928:async fn british_standing_item(
929:  conn: &mut redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection,
930:  entry: &british_fencing::store::LicenceIndexEntry,
931:) -> anyhow::Result<Option<FencerStandingItem>> {
932:  let Some(table) = british_fencing::store::read_table(conn, &entry.table_id).await? else {
933:    return Ok(None);
934:  };
935:
936:  Ok(
937:    select_british_row(&table, entry.row_index, &entry.licence)
938:      .map(|row| british_standing_item_for_row(&table, row)),
939:  )
940:}
941:
942:/// Pure lookup: the entry's `row_index` fast path, falling back to a scan by
943:/// licence on a miss or a mismatch. Split out from [`british_standing_item`]
944:/// so it is unit-testable without a live Redis connection.
945:fn select_british_row<'a>(
946:  table: &'a british_fencing::BritishRankingTable,
947:  row_index: usize,
948:  licence: &str,
949:) -> Option<&'a british_fencing::BritishRankingRow> {
950:  table
951:    .rows
952:    .get(row_index)
953:    .filter(|row| row.licence == licence)
954:    .or_else(|| table.rows.iter().find(|row| row.licence == licence))
955:}
956:
957:/// Builds a British standing item from one table's row. Pure, so this is
958:/// unit-testable without a live Redis connection. British has no analogue of
959:/// `regionId` (British Fencing publishes no regional dimension -- `None`,
960:/// the same `scope: "regional"`-with-`null`-region shape Division lists
961:/// already forced clients to handle) or the Unified-only `listCode`/`isNew`/
962:/// `pointsFloor`/`eligibility` fields.
963:fn british_standing_item_for_row(
964:  table: &british_fencing::BritishRankingTable,
965:  row: &british_fencing::BritishRankingRow,
966:) -> FencerStandingItem {
967:  let classifier = build_classifier_info(table.classifier);
968:  let key = build_standing_key(StandingScope::British, None, &classifier.code);
969:  let now = Utc::now();
970:  FencerStandingItem {
971:    key,
972:    scope: StandingScope::British,
973:    region_id: None,
974:    classifier,
975:    rank: row.rank.clone(),
976:    points: Some(row.total_points as f32),
977:    entrants: Some(table.rows.len()),
978:    movement: None,
979:    unified: None,
980:    british: Some(SourceFreshness {
981:      source_updated_at: Some(table.source_updated_at.timestamp()),
982:      fetched_at: Some(table.fetched_at.timestamp()),
983:      is_stale: Some(now - table.fetched_at > SOURCE_STALE_AFTER),
984:    }),
985:  }
986:}
987:
988:/// Builds a British Fencing composition from the same validated table payload
989:/// that produced the standing chip. The source publishes per-bucket counts,
990:/// and the parser reconstructs a deterministic selected set at ingestion;
991:/// this read path only projects that stored source evidence and verifies it
992:/// still supports the card total.
993:async fn resolve_british_composition(
994:  licence: Option<&str>,
995:  classifier: &ClassifierInfo,
996:  displayed_points: Option<f32>,
997:) -> StandingCompositionBody {
998:  let Some(licence) = licence else {
999:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::NotInSourceList);
1000:  };
1001:  let Some(points) = displayed_points else {
1002:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1003:  };
1004:
1005:  let mut conn = british_redis_connection().await;
1006:  let entries = match british_fencing::store::read_licence_index_entries(&mut conn, licence).await {
1007:    Ok(entries) => entries,
1008:    Err(error) => {
1009:      warn!(
1010:        licence,
1011:        ?error,
1012:        "Failed to read British rankings licence index for composition"
1013:      );
1014:      return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1015:    }
1016:  };
1017:
1018:  for entry in entries {
1019:    let table = match british_fencing::store::read_table(&mut conn, &entry.table_id).await {
1020:      Ok(Some(table)) => table,
1021:      Ok(None) => continue,
1022:      Err(error) => {
1023:        warn!(
1024:          licence,
1025:          table_id = %entry.table_id,
1026:          ?error,
1027:          "Failed to read British rankings table for composition"
1028:        );
1029:        return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1030:      }
1031:    };
1032:    if table.classifier.code() != classifier.code {
1033:      continue;
1034:    }
1035:    let Some(row) = select_british_row(&table, entry.row_index, licence) else {
1036:      continue;
1037:    };
1038:    return resolve_british_composition_body(&table, row, points);
1039:  }
1040:
1041:  unavailable(UnavailableReason::NotInSourceList)
1042:}
1043:
1044:/// Projects a parser-validated British row into the shared composition shape.
1045:/// Returning `upstreamUnavailable` for an impossible persisted index protects
1046:/// the endpoint from silently omitting a source result if a manually-corrupt
1047:/// Redis payload ever bypasses the ingestion validator.
1048:fn resolve_british_composition_body(
1049:  table: &british_fencing::BritishRankingTable,
1050:  row: &british_fencing::BritishRankingRow,
1051:  displayed_points: f32,
1052:) -> StandingCompositionBody {
1053:  let domestic_indexes = &row.counted_selection.domestic_event_indexes;
1054:  let international_indexes = &row.counted_selection.international_event_indexes;
1055:  if domestic_indexes.len() != row.domestic.counted_events
1056:    || international_indexes.len() != row.international.counted_events
1057:  {
1058:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1059:  }
1060:  for &index in domestic_indexes {
1061:    if !matches!(
1062:      table.events.get(index).map(|event| event.kind),
1063:      Some(british_fencing::BritishEventKind::Domestic)
1064:    ) {
1065:      return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1066:    }
1067:  }
1068:  for &index in international_indexes {
1069:    if !matches!(
1070:      table.events.get(index).map(|event| event.kind),
1071:      Some(british_fencing::BritishEventKind::International)
1072:    ) {
1073:      return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1074:    }
1075:  }
1076:
1077:  let selected_indexes = domestic_indexes
1078:    .iter()
1079:    .chain(international_indexes)
1080:    .copied()
1081:    .collect::<std::collections::HashSet<_>>();
1082:  let expected_count = row.domestic.counted_events + row.international.counted_events;
1083:  if selected_indexes.len() != expected_count {
1084:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1085:  }
1086:
1087:  let mut counted = Vec::with_capacity(expected_count);
1088:  let mut excluded = Vec::with_capacity(row.results.len().saturating_sub(expected_count));
1089:  for result in &row.results {
1090:    let Some(mut entry) = british_composition_entry(table, result) else {
1091:      return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1092:    };
1093:    if selected_indexes.contains(&result.event_index) {
1094:      counted.push(entry);
1095:    } else {
1096:      entry.excluded_reason = Some(ExcludedReason::DisplacedByBestN);
1097:      excluded.push(entry);
1098:    }
1099:  }
1100:  if counted.len() != expected_count {
1101:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1102:  }
1103:
1104:  let domestic_counted_total = counted
1105:    .iter()
1106:    .filter(|entry| entry.bucket == Some(CompositionEntryBucket::Domestic))
1107:    .map(|entry| entry.points)
1108:    .sum::<f32>();
1109:  let international_counted_total = counted
1110:    .iter()
1111:    .filter(|entry| entry.bucket == Some(CompositionEntryBucket::International))
1112:    .map(|entry| entry.points)
1113:    .sum::<f32>();
1114:  if (domestic_counted_total - row.domestic.points as f32).abs() > DETAIL_RECONCILE_TOLERANCE
1115:    || (international_counted_total - row.international.points as f32).abs()
1116:      > DETAIL_RECONCILE_TOLERANCE
1117:  {
1118:    warn!(
1119:      domestic_counted_total,
1120:      international_counted_total,
1121:      published_domestic = row.domestic.points,
1122:      published_international = row.international.points,
1123:      licence = row.licence,
1124:      table_id = table.table_id,
1125:      "British composition per-bucket subtotals did not reconcile with the published bucket totals"
1126:    );
1127:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile);
1128:  }
1129:
1130:  let counted_total = counted.iter().map(|entry| entry.points).sum::<f32>();
1131:  if (counted_total - displayed_points).abs() > DETAIL_RECONCILE_TOLERANCE {
1132:    warn!(
1133:      counted_total,
1134:      published_total = displayed_points,
1135:      licence = row.licence,
1136:      table_id = table.table_id,
1137:      "British composition did not reconcile with the displayed standing"
1138:    );
1139:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile);
1140:  }
1141:
1142:  StandingCompositionBody::Complete {
1143:    source: CompositionSource::BritishFencingLiveRanking,
1144:    as_of: table.source_updated_at.timestamp(),
1145:    retrieved_at: None,
1146:    rule: CountingRule::DomesticInternationalSplit {
1147:      label: format!(
1148:        "British Fencing counted {} domestic and {} international results",
1149:        row.domestic.counted_events, row.international.counted_events
1150:      ),
1151:      domestic_counted: row.domestic.counted_events,
1152:      international_counted: row.international.counted_events,
1153:    },
1154:    counted_total,
1155:    counted,
1156:    excluded,
1157:    counted_selection_ambiguous: Some(row.counted_selection.is_ambiguous),
1158:    excluded_availability: ExcludedAvailability::Complete,
1159:  }
1160:}

1162:fn british_composition_entry(
1163:  table: &british_fencing::BritishRankingTable,
1164:  result: &british_fencing::BritishRankingResult,
1165:) -> Option<CompositionEntry> {
1166:  let event = table.events.get(result.event_index)?;
1167:  Some(CompositionEntry {
1168:    event_name: event.name.clone(),
1169:    event_code: None,
1170:    source_event_id: None,

1173:    group: None,

1175:      british_fencing::BritishEventKind::Domestic => CompositionEntryBucket::Domestic,
1176:      british_fencing::BritishEventKind::International => CompositionEntryBucket::International,
1177:    }),
1178:    date: Some(event.date.to_string()),

1185:/// A failed reconciliation is different from a composition being unavailable
1186:/// for another reason: it explicitly says the displayed total cannot be
1187:/// supported by the source evidence. Do not surface a confident rank and
1188:/// points for that row. Unsupported breakdowns, transient fetch failures, and
1189:/// identity misses do not make the cached standing itself untrustworthy.
1190:///
1191:/// **Must be paired with [`total_is_rating_derived`].** After the points-floor
1192:/// exemption, [`UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile`] covers two cases: a
1193:/// genuine earned-total/evidence mismatch, and the structural refusal of a
1194:/// floored row (whose total is rating-derived, so no counted set can explain
1195:/// it). This function alone cannot tell them apart — every consumer that would
1196:/// treat a failed reconciliation as negative evidence about the standing must
1197:/// also consult `total_is_rating_derived` (as `retain_substantiated` and
1198:/// `should_record_did_not_reconcile` already do). A later call site that reads
1199:/// only this verdict will silently suppress healthy floored standings.
1200:fn composition_substantiates_summary(composition: &StandingCompositionBody) -> bool {
1201:  !matches!(
1202:    composition,
1203:    StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
1204:      reason: UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile
1205:    }
1206:  )
1207:}
1208:
1209:/// Whether this row's published total comes from a weapon-rating points floor
1210:/// rather than from results.
1211:///
1212:/// Keys on the presence of `points_floor` on the Unified enrichment — the same
1213:/// floored-ness signal catalog validation uses (`is_floored_row`), independent
1214:/// of whether the nested `weapon_rating` classification parsed. Such a total
1215:/// is rating-derived by construction, so no counted set can ever sum to it and
1216:/// its composition always refuses with [`UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile`]
1217:/// — see `docs/backend/standings.md` on the snapshot-side reconcile gate, whose
1218:/// only serving-time effect is to refuse exactly these rows. That refusal is
1219:/// the expected outcome for a floored row, not evidence that its total is
1220:/// wrong, so it must never be read as negative evidence about the standing
1221:/// itself. Pair with [`composition_substantiates_summary`] at every consumer.
1222:fn total_is_rating_derived(standing: &FencerStandingItem) -> bool {
1223:  standing
1224:    .unified
1225:    .as_ref()
1226:    .is_some_and(|unified| unified.points_floor.is_some())
1227:}
1228:
1229:/// Retains summaries unless the composition evidence explicitly says their
1230:/// published total did not reconcile. `None` represents no cached evidence,
1231:/// which must remain visible rather than causing the list endpoint to warm an
1232:/// on-demand source.
1233:///
1234:/// A points-floor row is exempt: its non-reconciliation is structural (see
1235:/// [`total_is_rating_derived`]), so honouring that verdict would delete a
1236:/// perfectly good standing from the list the first time anyone opened its
1237:/// breakdown. Exempting it here — rather than only at write time — also heals
1238:/// verdicts already persisted by earlier builds, without a cache bump.
1239:fn retain_substantiated(
1240:  items: Vec<(FencerStandingItem, Option<StandingCompositionBody>)>,
1241:) -> Vec<FencerStandingItem> {
1242:  items
1243:    .into_iter()
1244:    .filter_map(|(item, composition)| {
1245:      (total_is_rating_derived(&item)
1246:        || composition
1247:          .as_ref()
1248:          .is_none_or(composition_substantiates_summary))
1249:      .then_some(item)
1250:    })
1251:    .collect()
1252:}
1253:
1254:/// Whether a composition outcome is worth persisting as negative evidence
1255:/// against this standing's published total.
1256:///
1257:/// A points-floor row always refuses to reconcile, so recording that verdict
1258:/// would say nothing about the standing and only suppress it. `false` is
1259:/// written rather than the write being skipped, so a row that became floored
1260:/// after an earlier earned-total verdict overwrites it instead of inheriting
1261:/// it.
1262:fn should_record_did_not_reconcile(
1263:  standing: &FencerStandingItem,
1264:  composition: &StandingCompositionBody,
1265:) -> bool {
1266:  !composition_substantiates_summary(composition) && !total_is_rating_derived(standing)
1267:}

1269:fn composition_verdict_cache_field(
1270:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
1271:  standing: &FencerStandingItem,
1272:) -> String {
1273:  // The displayed total is part of the identity: a refreshed published value
1274:  // is unknown until its own composition request has been reconciled.
1275:  format!(
1276:    "{}:{}:{:08x}",
1277:    fencer_id,
1278:    standing.key,
1279:    standing.points.unwrap_or_default().to_bits()
1280:  )

1283:async fn cached_composition_verdict(
1284:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
1285:  standing: &FencerStandingItem,
1286:) -> Option<StandingCompositionBody> {
1287:  let cache = RedisCache::get().await;
1288:  let mut connection = cache
1289:    .get_connection()
1290:    .expect("RedisCache should provide a Redis connection");
1291:  let field = composition_verdict_cache_field(fencer_id, standing);
1292:  match connection
1293:    .hget::<_, _, Option<bool>>(COMPOSITION_VERDICT_CACHE_KEY, field)
1294:    .await
1295:  {
1296:    Ok(Some(true)) => Some(unavailable(UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile)),
1297:    Ok(Some(false) | None) => None,
1298:    Err(error) => {
1299:      warn!(
1300:        fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1301:        standing_key = %standing.key,
1302:        %error,
1303:        "Failed to read cached standings composition verdict"
1304:      );
1305:      None
1306:    }
1307:  }
1308:}

1310:async fn persist_composition_verdict(
1311:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
1312:  standing: &FencerStandingItem,
1313:  composition: &StandingCompositionBody,
1314:) {
1315:  let cache = RedisCache::get().await;
1316:  let mut connection = cache
1317:    .get_connection()
1318:    .expect("RedisCache should provide a Redis connection");
1319:  let field = composition_verdict_cache_field(fencer_id, standing);
1320:  let did_not_reconcile = should_record_did_not_reconcile(standing, composition);
1321:  if let Err(error) = connection
1322:    .hset::<_, _, _, ()>(COMPOSITION_VERDICT_CACHE_KEY, field, did_not_reconcile)
1323:    .await
1324:  {
1325:    warn!(
1326:      fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1327:      standing_key = %standing.key,
1328:      %error,
1329:      "Failed to persist standings composition verdict"
1330:    );
1331:  }
1332:}

1366:/// Scope ordering: Unified, then National, then Regional, then British.
1367:/// `sort_standings` sorts scope-major -- every row of a higher-priority
1368:/// scope precedes every row of a lower one, regardless of category;
1369:/// `standings_sort_scope_first_then_orders_categories_within_scope` pins the
1370:/// actual behaviour. A single ranking function keeps this rule stable
1371:/// regardless of which scopes a given fencer actually has, rather than
1372:/// depending on a hardcoded per-call-site array order.
1373:fn scope_priority(scope: StandingScope) -> u8 {
1374:  match scope {
1375:    StandingScope::Unified => 0,
1376:    StandingScope::National => 1,
1377:    StandingScope::Regional => 2,
1378:    StandingScope::British => 3,
1379:  }
1380:}

1382:fn sort_standings(items: &mut [FencerStandingItem]) {
1383:  items.sort_by_key(|item| {
1384:    (
1385:      scope_priority(item.scope),
1386:      category_priority(item.classifier.category),
1387:    )
1388:  });
1389:}

1477:/// Selects the correct source family for a standing. Youth and regional lists
1478:/// must not be widened into the national-detail route: their source data and
1479:/// aggregation policies differ. Veteran and Division IA/II national lists
1480:/// deliberately remain unsupported.
1481:pub(crate) fn composition_route(scope: StandingScope, category: EventCategory) -> CompositionRoute {
1482:  match (scope, category) {
1483:    (
1484:      StandingScope::National,
1485:      EventCategory::Cadet | EventCategory::Junior | EventCategory::Senior,
1486:    ) => CompositionRoute::NationalCjs,
1487:    (StandingScope::National, EventCategory::Y10 | EventCategory::Y12 | EventCategory::Y14) => {
1488:      CompositionRoute::YouthNational
1489:    }
1490:    (StandingScope::Regional, _) => CompositionRoute::Regional,
1491:    (
1492:      StandingScope::Unified,
1493:      EventCategory::Cadet | EventCategory::Junior | EventCategory::Senior,
1494:    ) => CompositionRoute::UnifiedRankings,
1495:    (StandingScope::British, _) => CompositionRoute::British,
1496:    (StandingScope::National | StandingScope::Unified, _) => CompositionRoute::Unsupported,
1497:  }
1498:}

1501:/// scope/category pair. Each resolver retains its own reconciliation and
1502:/// availability behaviour so an upstream or source-list refusal is not
1503:/// mistaken for an unsupported list.
1504:pub(crate) async fn resolve_composition_body(
1505:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
1506:  standing: &FencerStandingItem,
1507:  british_licence: Option<&str>,
1508:) -> StandingCompositionBody {
1509:  match composition_route(standing.scope, standing.classifier.category) {
1510:    CompositionRoute::NationalCjs => {
1511:      national_composition(fencer_id, &standing.classifier, standing.points).await
1512:    }
1513:    CompositionRoute::YouthNational => {
1514:      resolve_youth_composition(
1515:        fencer_id,
1516:        &standing.classifier.code,
1517:        standing.classifier.category,
1518:        standing.points,
1519:      )
1520:      .await
1521:    }
1522:    CompositionRoute::Regional => {
1523:      resolve_regional_composition(
1524:        fencer_id,
1525:        &standing.classifier.code,
1526:        standing.classifier.category,
1527:        standing.region_id,
1528:        standing.points,
1529:      )
1530:      .await
1531:    }
1532:    CompositionRoute::UnifiedRankings => {
1533:      resolve_unified_composition(fencer_id, &standing.classifier, standing.points).await
1534:    }
1535:    CompositionRoute::British => {
1536:      resolve_british_composition(british_licence, &standing.classifier, standing.points).await
1537:    }

1539:      reason: UnavailableReason::ListNotSupported,

1543:
1544:/// Unified composition keeps the source's declared counted set intact.
1545:///
1546:/// The counted set is served from the published snapshot, which already stores
1547:/// every carried result USA Fencing attributed to the row and whose scores sum
1548:/// to the published points by construction (`unified_catalog::
1549:/// validate_catalog_list` refuses to publish a list where they do not). No
1550:/// upstream request is required to answer "what makes up this total".
1551:///
1552:/// The source-published *excluded* set is the one thing the snapshot does not
1553:/// carry: it exists only behind `/rankings/{source_ranking_id}/results`, whose
1554:/// handle USA Fencing re-mints on every ranking recompute — many times a day,
1555:/// against a catalog refreshed daily — so a stored handle is usually already
1556:/// dead (HTTP 404). That fetch is therefore a best-effort enrichment: when it
1557:/// succeeds the response carries the full counted-plus-excluded set exactly as
1558:/// before, and when it fails the counted breakdown is still returned, with
1559:/// [`ExcludedAvailability::Unavailable`] marking the excluded set as
1560:/// unretrieved rather than empty.
1561:async fn resolve_unified_composition(
1562:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
1563:  classifier: &ClassifierInfo,
1564:  _displayed_points: Option<f32>,
1565:) -> StandingCompositionBody {
1566:  let Some(classifier) = RecognizedClassifier::from_code(&classifier.code) else {
1567:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::ListNotSupported);
1568:  };
1569:  let Some(usaf_id) = resolve_standings_usaf_id(fencer_id).await.ok().flatten() else {
1570:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::NotInSourceList);
1571:  };
1572:  let active = match unified_snapshot::read_active_list(classifier).await {
1573:    Ok(Some(active)) => Some(active),
1574:    Ok(None) => None,
1575:    Err(error) => {
1576:      warn!(
1577:        fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1578:        %classifier,
1579:        ?error,
1580:        "Failed to read the active Unified snapshot for standings composition"
1581:      );
1582:      None
1583:    }
1584:  };
1585:  let Some((snapshot_id, list)) = active else {
1586:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1587:  };
1588:  let Some(row) = list
1589:    .standings
1590:    .iter()
1591:    .find(|record| record.standing.id == Some(usaf_id))
1592:  else {
1593:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::NotInSourceList);
1594:  };
1595:  // The snapshot can change between the parent fencer-standing lookup and
1596:  // this on-open request. Reconcile against the exact active row that
1597:  // published these results, never a possibly older card value.
1598:  let points = row.standing.points;
1599:  let Some(as_of) = list
1600:    .source_updated_at
1601:    .map(|timestamp| timestamp.timestamp())
1602:  else {
1603:    warn!(
1604:      fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1605:      %classifier,
1606:      "Active Unified snapshot carries no source-update pivot to date a composition with"
1607:    );
1608:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1609:  };
1610:
1611:  // Try the richer answer first, so the snapshot arm's mapping and tournament
1612:  // lookup are only paid for when the enrichment could not supply them.
1613:  if let Some(body) =
1614:    unified_full_result_body(fencer_id, classifier, row, &list, points, as_of, || {
1615:      unified_client::resolve_live_fencer_results(
1616:        &snapshot_id,
1617:        classifier,
1618:        &row.source_ranking_uuid,
1619:        row.source_user_id,
1620:        &row.standing.name,
1621:      )
1622:    })
1623:    .await
1624:  {
1625:    return body;
1626:  }
1627:
1628:  let mut snapshot_counted = match unified_contributions(&row.counted) {
1629:    Ok(candidates) => candidates,
1630:    Err(error) => {
1631:      warn!(
1632:        fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1633:        %classifier,
1634:        %error,
1635:        "Snapshot Unified counted set contained an unmappable source result"
1636:      );
1637:      return unavailable(UnavailableReason::ResultMappingUnavailable);
1638:    }
1639:  };
1640:  // The reconcile-or-refuse gate runs against the set we are certain of. A
1641:  // points-floor row legitimately fails it: its points come from the fencer's
1642:  // weapon rating, not from results, so no counted list can explain the total —
1643:  // and the enrichment arm's own gate has already rejected it for the same
1644:  // reason, which is how it reached this point.
1645:  let snapshot_counted_total = counted_total(&row.counted);
1646:  if (snapshot_counted_total - points).abs() > DETAIL_RECONCILE_TOLERANCE {
1647:    warn!(
1648:      fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1649:      %classifier,
1650:      snapshot_counted_total,
1651:      published_total = points,
1652:      points_floor = row.points_floor.is_some(),
1653:      "Snapshot Unified counted set did not reconcile with the active standing"
1654:    );
1655:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile);
1656:  }
1657:  populate_source_event_ids(&mut snapshot_counted, classifier).await;
1658:
1659:  unified_snapshot_composition_body(&list, &snapshot_counted, snapshot_counted_total, as_of)
1660:}

1662:/// Assembles the Unified body from the counted set the published snapshot
1663:/// already holds. `excluded` is deliberately empty and flagged
1664:/// [`ExcludedAvailability::Unavailable`]: this arm never saw the source's
1665:/// excluded results, so it must not imply there were none. `retrieved_at` is
1666:/// likewise absent — nothing was retrieved on this request, and the snapshot's
1667:/// own provenance is already carried by `as_of`.
1668:fn unified_snapshot_composition_body(
1669:  list: &unified_snapshot::UnifiedListPayload,
1670:  counted: &[StandingContribution],
1671:  counted_total: f32,
1672:  as_of: i64,
1673:) -> StandingCompositionBody {
1674:  unified_body(
1675:    list,
1676:    as_of,
1677:    None,
1678:    counted_total,
1679:    counted
1680:      .iter()
1681:      .map(|contribution| composition_entry(contribution, None))
1682:      .collect(),
1683:    Vec::new(),
1684:    ExcludedAvailability::Unavailable,
1685:  )
1686:}

1688:/// Attempts the per-fencer upstream fetch that carries the source-published
1689:/// excluded set, returning `None` whenever it cannot produce a body the caller
1690:/// should prefer over the snapshot-derived one. Every `None` is logged: an
1691:/// unavailable live lookup is expected background noise, but a mapping or
1692:/// reconciliation failure means the two source views disagree.
1693:///
1694:/// The fetch itself is injected as `fetch_results` so tests can exercise the
1695:/// fetch-fails-then-fall-back-to-the-snapshot wiring without the real
1696:/// upstream call's cache, Redis gate, and HTTP dependencies; production
1697:/// always passes [`unified_client::resolve_live_fencer_results`].
1698:async fn unified_full_result_body<F, Fut>(
1699:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
1700:  classifier: RecognizedClassifier,
1701:  row: &unified_snapshot::UnifiedStandingRecord,
1702:  list: &unified_snapshot::UnifiedListPayload,
1703:  points: f32,
1704:  as_of: i64,
1705:  fetch_results: F,
1706:) -> Option<StandingCompositionBody>
1707:where
1708:  F: FnOnce() -> Fut,
1709:  Fut: std::future::Future<Output = unified_client::Result<unified_client::UnifiedFencerResults>>,
1710:{
1711:  let results = match fetch_results().await {
1712:    Ok(results) => results,
1713:    Err(error) => {
1714:      match error {
1715:        unified_client::UnifiedClientError::BudgetExhausted => debug!(
1716:          fencer_id = %fencer_id, %classifier,
1717:          "Unified excluded-result resolution skipped because the request-unit budget is exhausted"
1718:        ),
1719:        unified_client::UnifiedClientError::LiveLookupNoRows { .. } => debug!(
1720:          fencer_id = %fencer_id, %classifier, source_user_id = row.source_user_id, ?error,
1721:          "Unified excluded-result live lookup did not resolve this snapshot row"
1722:        ),
1723:        unified_client::UnifiedClientError::LiveLookupUserMismatch { .. }
1724:        | unified_client::UnifiedClientError::LiveLookupPageLimit { .. } => warn!(
1725:          fencer_id = %fencer_id, %classifier, source_user_id = row.source_user_id, ?error,
1726:          "Unified excluded-result live lookup disagreed with this snapshot row"
1727:        ),
1728:        unified_client::UnifiedClientError::FencerResultsFetch { ranking_id, .. } => debug!(
1729:          fencer_id = %fencer_id, %classifier, source_ranking_id = ranking_id, ?error,
1730:          "Unified excluded-result fetch failed after live ranking resolution"
1731:        ),
1732:        _ => debug!(fencer_id = %fencer_id, %classifier, ?error,
1733:          "Unified excluded-result fetch failed after live ranking resolution"),
1734:      }
1735:      return None;
1736:    }
1737:  };
1738:  let mut candidates = match unified_contributions(&results.results) {
1739:    Ok(candidates) => candidates,
1740:    Err(error) => {
1741:      warn!(
1742:        fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1743:        %classifier,
1744:        %error,
1745:        "Unified full result set contained an unmappable source result"
1746:      );
1747:      return None;
1748:    }
1749:  };
1750:  populate_source_event_ids(&mut candidates, classifier).await;
1751:
1752:  match resolve_unified_composition_body(
1753:    list,
1754:    &results.results,
1755:    &candidates,
1756:    points,
1757:    as_of,
1758:    results.retrieved_at.timestamp(),
1759:  ) {
1760:    body @ StandingCompositionBody::Complete { .. } => Some(body),
1761:    StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable { reason } => {
1762:      warn!(
1763:        fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1764:        %classifier,
1765:        ?reason,
1766:        "Unified full result set was rejected; serving the snapshot counted set alone"
1767:      );
1768:      None
1769:    }
1770:  }
1771:}

1775:  results
1776:    .iter()
1777:    .filter(|result| result.counted)
1778:    .map(|result| result.ranking_score)
1779:    .sum()
1780:}

1786:/// Maps every required upstream event field into the shared composition shape.
1787:/// Unknown event codes, categories, or tournament classifications reject the
1788:/// entire response: omitting an event would falsely claim a complete result
1789:/// set and could mask a reconciliation mismatch.
1790:fn unified_contributions(
1791:  results: &[UnifiedResult],
1792:) -> std::result::Result<Vec<StandingContribution>, String> {
1793:  results
1794:    .iter()
1795:    .map(|result| {
1796:      let event_classifier = RecognizedClassifier::from_code(&result.event_code)
1797:        .filter(|classifier| !classifier.team)
1798:        .ok_or_else(|| format!("unrecognized individual event code {:?}", result.event_code))?;
1799:      let category = ranking_category_for(event_classifier.category)
1800:        .ok_or_else(|| format!("unsupported event category in {:?}", result.event_code))?;
1801:      let event_type = classify_event(&EventClassificationInputs {
1802:        scope: None,
1803:        tournament_name: &result.tournament_name,
1804:        tournament_id: &result.event_id.to_string(),
1805:        location: "",
1806:        usa_region: None,
1807:        category: event_classifier.category,
1808:        allow_international_default: true,
1809:      })
1810:      .event_type
1811:      .ok_or_else(|| {
1812:        format!(
1813:          "unclassified Unified tournament {:?}",
1814:          result.tournament_name
1815:        )
1816:      })?;
1817:      let placement = result.placement.ok_or_else(|| {
1818:        format!(
1819:          "missing placement for Unified event {:?}",
1820:          result.event_code
1821:        )
1822:      })?;
1823:      let mut contribution = StandingContribution::slot(
1824:        result.event_id.to_string(),
1825:        format!("{}-{}", result.tournament_name, result.event_code),
1826:        event_type,
1827:        category,
1828:        ResultDate::with_day(
1829:          result.event_date.year(),
1830:          result.event_date.month(),
1831:          result.event_date.day(),
1832:        ),
1833:        placement,
1834:        result.ranking_score,
1835:      )
1836:      .with_event_name(result.tournament_name.clone())
1837:      .with_event_code(result.event_code.clone());
1838:      // Unified publishes one undifferentiated best-N pool. The legacy
1839:      // national Group I/II split does not apply to these source-declared
1840:      // results, even when their event type normally belongs to Group I.
1841:      contribution.group = ContributionGroup::None;
1842:      Ok(contribution)
1843:    })
1844:    .collect()
1845:}
1846:
1847:/// Builds Unified's source-declared counted/excluded sets after every result
1848:/// has passed strict mapping. Unlike legacy points sources, Unified does not
1849:/// let Flunge recompute which entries count; only its published boolean does.
1850:fn resolve_unified_composition_body(
1851:  list: &unified_snapshot::UnifiedListPayload,
1852:  results: &[UnifiedResult],
1853:  candidates: &[StandingContribution],
1854:  points: f32,
1855:  as_of: i64,
1856:  retrieved_at: i64,
1857:) -> StandingCompositionBody {
1858:  if results.len() != candidates.len() {
1859:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable);
1860:  }
1861:  let counted_total = counted_total(results);
1862:  if (counted_total - points).abs() > DETAIL_RECONCILE_TOLERANCE {
1863:    warn!(
1864:      counted_total,
1865:      published_total = points,
1866:      "Unified composition did not reconcile with the active standing"
1867:    );
1868:    return unavailable(UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile);
1869:  }
1870:
1871:  let mut counted = Vec::new();
1872:  let mut excluded = Vec::new();
1873:  for (result, contribution) in results.iter().zip(candidates) {
1874:    let mut entry = composition_entry(contribution, None);
1875:    if result.counted {
1876:      counted.push(entry);
1877:    } else {
1878:      entry.excluded_reason = Some(ExcludedReason::SourceDidNotCount);
1879:      excluded.push(entry);
1880:    }
1881:  }
1882:
1883:  unified_body(
1884:    list,
1885:    as_of,
1886:    Some(retrieved_at),
1887:    counted_total,
1888:    counted,
1889:    excluded,
1890:    ExcludedAvailability::Complete,
1891:  )
1892:}

1898:  as_of: i64,

1907:    as_of,
1908:    retrieved_at,
1909:    rule: CountingRule::BestN {
1910:      label: format!("Best {} results", list.max_results),
1911:      best: list.max_results as usize,
1912:    },
1913:    counted_total,
1914:    counted,

1921:/// Youth-national (Y10/Y12/Y14) composition is fetched from the tracked
1922:/// fencer's per-fencer points page and evaluated with Youth's own caps and
1923:/// slot-reoccurrence window.
1924:async fn resolve_youth_composition(
1925:  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
1926:  classifier_code: &str,
1927:  category: EventCategory,
1928:  points: Option<f32>,
1929:) -> StandingCompositionBody {
1930:  let Some(points) = points else {
1931:    return StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
1932:      reason: UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable,
1933:    };
1934:  };
1935:  let Some(classifier) = RecognizedClassifier::from_code(classifier_code) else {
1936:    return StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
1937:      reason: UnavailableReason::ListNotSupported,
1938:    };
1939:  };
1940:  let Some(usaf_id) = resolve_standings_usaf_id(fencer_id).await.ok().flatten() else {
1941:    return StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
1942:      reason: UnavailableReason::NotInSourceList,
1943:    };
1944:  };
1945:  let youth_category = match category {
1946:    EventCategory::Y10 => YouthCategory::Y10,
1947:    EventCategory::Y12 => YouthCategory::Y12,
1948:    EventCategory::Y14 => YouthCategory::Y14,
1949:    _ => {
1950:      return StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
1951:        reason: UnavailableReason::ListNotSupported,
1952:      };
1953:    }
1954:  };
1955:
1956:  let mut candidates =
1957:    match usafencing_api::get_national_fencer_breakdown(classifier, usaf_id).await {
1958:      Ok(NationalFencerBreakdown::Contributions(candidates)) => candidates,
1959:      // A 404 on a list USA Fencing does serve means this fencer holds no rows
1960:      // on it — that is a fact about the fencer, so it reads as
1961:      // `NotInSourceList` rather than the `UpstreamUnavailable` an error used
1962:      // to produce. `ListNotBreakdownBacked` is unreachable behind the
1963:      // youth-category match above, and maps to the same `ListNotSupported`
1964:      // that match already returns.
1965:      Ok(NationalFencerBreakdown::FencerNotRanked) => {
1966:        return StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
1967:          reason: UnavailableReason::NotInSourceList,
1968:        };
1969:      }
1970:      Ok(NationalFencerBreakdown::ListNotBreakdownBacked) => {
1971:        return StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
1972:          reason: UnavailableReason::ListNotSupported,
1973:        };
1974:      }
1975:      Err(err) => {
1976:        warn!(
1977:          fencer_id = %fencer_id,
1978:          classifier = %classifier,
1979:          ?err,
1980:          "Failed to fetch Youth-national breakdown for composition"
1981:        );
1982:        return StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
1983:          reason: UnavailableReason::UpstreamUnavailable,
1984:        };
1985:      }
1986:    };
1987:  populate_source_event_ids(&mut candidates, classifier).await;
1988:
1989:  build_composition_body(
1990:    CompositionSource::NationalPointsPage,
1991:    CountingRule::YouthBestFour {
1992:      label: "Best 4 results, with per-age caps".to_string(),
1993:    },
1994:    WindowKind::SlotReoccurrence,
1995:    AggregationPolicy::YouthBestFour(youth_caps(youth_category)),
1996:    &candidates,
1997:    points,
1998:  )
1999:}

2113:impl WindowKind {
2114:  fn counting(
2115:    &self,
2116:    policy: AggregationPolicy,
2117:    candidates: &[StandingContribution],
2118:  ) -> Vec<StandingContribution> {

2125:
2126:/// Builds the reconcile-or-refuse body shared by the two live points-page
2127:/// sources. The warning retains both totals, which is the operational signal
2128:/// needed to investigate Youth reconciliation without weakening the gate.
2129:fn build_composition_body(
2130:  source: CompositionSource,
2131:  rule: CountingRule,
2132:  window: WindowKind,
2133:  policy: AggregationPolicy,
2134:  candidates: &[StandingContribution],
2135:  points: f32,
2136:) -> StandingCompositionBody {
2137:  let counting = window.counting(policy, candidates);
2138:  let drop_map = drop_reasons(policy, candidates, &counting);
2139:  let counted_total: f32 = counting
2140:    .iter()
2141:    .map(|contribution| contribution.points)
2142:    .sum();
2143:
2144:  if (counted_total - points).abs() > DETAIL_RECONCILE_TOLERANCE {
2145:    warn!(
2146:      counted_total,
2147:      published_total = points,
2148:      "Composition candidate pool did not reconcile with the displayed points total"
2149:    );
2150:    return StandingCompositionBody::Unavailable {
2151:      reason: UnavailableReason::DidNotReconcile,
2152:    };
2153:  }
2154:
2155:  let counted: Vec<_> = counting
2156:    .iter()
2157:    .map(|contribution| composition_entry(contribution, None))
2158:    .collect();
2159:  let excluded = candidates
2160:    .iter()
2161:    .filter(|candidate| {
2162:      !counting
2163:        .iter()
2164:        .any(|counted| counted.result_id == candidate.result_id)
2165:    })
2166:    .map(|candidate| {
2167:      let reason = drop_map
2168:        .get(&candidate.result_id)
2169:        .map(excluded_reason)
2170:        .unwrap_or(ExcludedReason::DisplacedByBestN);
2171:      composition_entry_with_excluded_reason(candidate, Some(reason))
2172:    })
2173:    .collect();
2174:
2175:  StandingCompositionBody::Complete {
2176:    source,
2177:    as_of: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
2178:    retrieved_at: None,
2179:    rule,
2180:    counted_total,
2181:    counted,
2182:    excluded,
2183:    counted_selection_ambiguous: None,
2184:    // Youth and regional exclusions are derived from the same candidate pool
2185:    // that produced the counted set, so the excluded list is always whole.
2186:    excluded_availability: ExcludedAvailability::Complete,
2187:  }
2188:}

2190:/// Resolves composition for a national Cadet/Junior/Senior standing from the

2290:  entry: &NationalCompositionEntry,
2291:  points: f32,
2292:) -> std::result::Result<StandingCompositionBody, (f32, f32)> {
2293:  let policy = AggregationPolicy::GroupSplit {
2294:    group_i_best: entry.group_i_best,
2295:    group_ii_best: entry.group_ii_best,
2296:  };
2297:  // The national detail parser reconciles this family with the Group I/II
2298:  // aggregation alone. Do not apply slot-reoccurrence roll-off or season
2299:  // windowing here: the parser has not validated that extra step for the
2300:  // composition it emits, so exclusions must only ever be labelled with the
2301:  // plain Group I/II diagnosis this selection actually applied — never a
2302:  // roll-off or prior-season diagnosis inferred from data this policy never
2303:  // consulted. `drop_reasons_without_window_diagnoses` enforces that.
2304:  let counting = counting_for_policy(policy, &entry.contributions);
2305:  let counted_total: f32 = counting.iter().map(|c| c.points).sum();
2306:
2307:  if (counted_total - points).abs() > DETAIL_RECONCILE_TOLERANCE {

item.text: The key change separates the shared licence value from permission to use it: every tracker reads the same record, while standings still require the viewer—or a share-link owner—to track the fencer. The migration also preserves conflicting old values for human reconciliation.
